test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a survey, it is found that out of 301 women, 24 women had impaired fasting glucose (IFG). If null hypothesis to be tested is that 6.3% have IFG and alternative hypothesis is that percentage is more than 6.3, then the value of test statistic is:
solution:
The correct answer is **1.2**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Hypothesis Testing:

__
 
• Null Hypothesis (H₀): The proportion of women with impaired fasting glucose (IFG) is 6.3%, i.e., p = 0.063.
 
• Alternative Hypothesis (Hₐ): The proportion of women with IFG is greater than 6.3%, i.e., p > 0.063.
 
• The test statistic for a proportion is calculated using the formula:

 z = frac{hat{p} - p}{sqrt{(p(1-p))/(n)}}
 
• Where:

 hat{p} = (24)/(301) approx 0.0797

 p = 0.063

 n = 301
 
• Calculating the test statistic:

 z = (0.0797 - 0.063)/(sqrt{frac{0.063 times (1-0.063)){301}}} approx 1.2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 Explanation of Options:

**Option 1: 0.87**

 
• Incorrect because it underestimates the test statistic.
 
• This value might result from an incorrect calculation of the sample proportion or standard error.

**Option 2: 1.86**

 
• Incorrect because it overestimates the test statistic.
 
• This value might result from an incorrect assumption about the sample size or the null proportion.

**Option 3: 1.2**

 
• Correct as it accurately reflects the calculated test statistic using the given data.
 
• The calculation aligns with the standard formula for testing a proportion.

**Option 4: 1.56**

 
• Incorrect because it is higher than the correct value of the test statistic.
 
• This value might result from an error in calculating the sample proportion or standard error.

***Hence, the value of the test statistic is correctly calculated as 1.2.***
